VTuber Tracker v2

Reads your camera picture, finds your face, body and hands on this PC, and sends the result to the avatar. Nothing leaves this PC. Keep this window open while you stream (it may sit behind other windows).

Where the picture comes from

  1. In OBS, right-click your camera source and choose Windowed Projector (Source). Leave that window open, not minimised.
  2. Press the button below and pick the window called Windowed Projector in the Window tab.

Options

face, body and hands all use this one switch
Look at the camera with a relaxed face and your mouth closed. Press the button, then hold still for two seconds. Do it once per session (light and camera height change from day to day).

Calibration in use: checking...

Song sound for the hand line

Press Start, choose Entire screen, tick Also share system audio, then Share. Only the sound is used; nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

Leave empty to use the sound of the test video above. It is never played on the speakers.

What the tracker sees

Shown the way it goes out on stream (after mirror). White dots = face, blue = shoulders and arms, gold = hands.
